# BillCrafter

> Free online invoice generator and AI receipt/invoice OCR scanner for freelancers, contractors, and small businesses. Create invoices, estimates, quotes and receipts in the browser (pixel-accurate vector PDF, no watermark), or scan paper receipts and PDF invoices to clean Excel (.xlsx) & CSV spreadsheets. No signup required to start. Operated by CCC STUDIO (United States).

## What it does

- **WYSIWYG Invoice, Estimate, Quote & Receipt Generator**: type directly onto the sheet; totals and tax calculate live.
- **AI Invoice & Receipt OCR Scanner** (`/invoice-ocr-scanner` & `/receipt-to-csv-converter`): upload PDF invoices, phone receipt photos, or paste screenshots (`⌘V`/`Ctrl+V`). Structured vision AI extracts vendor details, tax IDs, dates, currency, itemized lines, tax, and tips — with automatic `Subtotal + Tax = Total` arithmetic verification.
- **Multi-format Spreadsheet & PDF Exports**:
  - Clean UTF-8 BOM `.csv` (Itemized Lines, 1-row-per-receipt Expense Report Ledger, or QuickBooks/Xero import columns).
  - Genuine two-sheet Microsoft Excel `.xlsx` workbooks (`Summary` + `Line Items`) with live `=SUM()` formulas.
  - One-click bridge from OCR straight into the Invoice Editor to recreate a clean PDF or bundle supplier receipts into a **client reimbursement invoice** with receipt photos attached.
- **45 free, editable templates** across 8 layouts and 9 industry categories.
- **Multi-currency & global tax support**: 25+ currencies incl. USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, JPY, HKD, TWD, INR, and USDT/USDC/GRAM.
- **Generous 100% free model**:
  - Without an account: 1 PDF invoice export/day + 3 AI OCR scans/day (plus unlimited sample-bill testing).
  - With a free account ($0, no paid plans): unlimited PDF exports, 20 AI OCR scans/day, 10-file batch receipt merging, e-signature, share links, recurring invoices, and outbound invoice email (up to 3 emails/day anti-abuse cap).

## Built for how trades and services actually bill

- **Job site address** — separate from the billing address, because trades bill the work location.
- **Sections with their own subtotals** — group lines under Labor and Materials, Reimbursable Expenses, or rate bands like "Senior consultant — $185/hr".
- **Deposit due & Milestone payment schedule** — request a percentage/fixed booking deposit and print a multi-stage payment schedule right on the sheet.
- **Job & Receipt photos** — up to six captioned before/after or expense-receipt photos at the foot of the invoice, exported inside the PDF.
- **Timesheet mode** — dated entries, hours per row, and an automatic total-hours summary line.
- **E-signature & Crypto payment block** — sign invoices online or include a scannable USDT/USDC/GRAM wallet QR code.

## Languages

Invoice generator available in 15 languages at `https://billcrafter.com/<code>` (with server-rendered `<html lang>` and market-specific currency/tax defaults):
English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Traditional Chinese, Russian, Bengali, Korean, Japanese, Dutch, Swedish, Indonesian, Vietnamese.
Localized AI Invoice OCR & Receipt-to-CSV tools are also available natively in German (`/de/invoice-ocr-scanner`), Spanish (`/es/invoice-ocr-scanner`), French (`/fr/invoice-ocr-scanner`), Japanese (`/ja/invoice-ocr-scanner`), Traditional Chinese (`/zh-Hant/invoice-ocr-scanner`), and Portuguese (`/pt/invoice-ocr-scanner`).

## Notes

- Privacy: Guest OCR uploads are processed strictly in volatile memory via Google Cloud Vertex AI (enterprise zero-training governance) and discarded immediately after extraction.
- BillCrafter is a document and extraction utility, not an accounting or legal firm. Tax and e-invoicing rules vary by jurisdiction.
- Content use: search indexing and AI-assistant citation are welcome; model training is not (`Content-Signal: search=yes,ai-input=yes,ai-train=no`).
